''See also: [[High Council (Elder Empire) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] serves as the leadership body for the [[Consultant's Guild{{!}}Consultant’s Guild]] and acts as the voice of the [[Am’haranai]]. Comprised of three members—including [[Yala the High Mason]] and [[Tyril]] the High Shepherd—the [[Councilors]] are also known as [[Architects]]. They view themselves as the foundational designers and protectors of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]], tasked with shepherding its people and maintaining prosperity through their guidance. In formal settings, the [[Councilors]] typically stand around a waist-high white column rather than using chairs. Historically, the [[Council]] has functioned as a stabilizing force, though they have also been involved in suppressing secrets regarding the original [[Am’haranai]]. Following the death of the Emperor, the [[Council]] has faced significant challenges regarding the stability of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] and the potential resurgence of the [[Great Elders]]. To combat this threat, the [[Council]] has considered various strategies, such as releasing the [[Regents]] to serve as warriors against the [[Elders]] or dismantling imperial technologies like the [[Optasia]]. While they aim to preserve [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] through the strength of the [[Guilds]], their decisions are often made in consultation with other [[Architects]], such as [[Readers]] and historians, to navigate the collapse of existing power structures.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a body that makes decisions regarding the [[Fate{{!}}fate]] of the world, the High [[Council]] sought to have [[Shera]] assassinate the Emperor earlier than originally planned. It is suggested that this group may have possessed prior knowledge of the Emperor's intentions, especially after they ordered the sealing of the room containing the coffins. While they held [[Authority{{!}}authority]] over [[Yala the High Mason{{!}}Yala]]'s status, this particular decision was not made by the [[Council]] alone. Furthermore, they maintain the power to execute any [[Consultants]] who disclose secrets belonging to the [[Guild]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] wanted [[Shera]] to kill the Emperor ahead of schedule.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] is a group that may have known about the Emperor's plan.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] ordered the room containing the coffins to be sealed up.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] did not make the decision regarding [[Yala the High Mason{{!}}Yala]]'s status alone.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] makes decisions about the [[Fate{{!}}fate]] of the world.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] has the power to execute [[Consultants]] who reveal [[Guild]] secrets.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“I have orders from the High Council,” she said, looking into his eyes with pleading.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“Gardener Meia,” Shera said, in a mock-serious tone, “are you asking me to ignore the commands of the High Council?”<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c12" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“Do you trust Yala and the High Council to make better decisions about the fate of the world than the Emperor?”<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}
